title: Can I SILENCE Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess session on the drawback site: each side has a secret random handicap and he plays without knowing his own drawback, deducing it from the site's hints. Goal: win three games vs online humans.
rules: Standard setup; each player gets one secret random drawback (with hard drawbacks enabled); opponent's drawback is revealed after the game.
No check/checkmate: kings can be captured; moving into check is legal; capturing the enemy king wins.
If your drawback makes you have no legal moves / you violate a lose-condition drawback, you lose.
The site highlights moves your drawback requires.

Drawbacks seen: Cowardly (if your opponent captures, you must move backwards), Warlord (your king must be off the first two ranks), Devil on Your Shoulder (a devil suggests terrible moves; disobey 7 turns in a row and you must obey on the 8th), Pacman (if you can capture a pawn, you must).
win_condition: Capture the enemy king (or opponent loses via drawback / time). Video goal: 3 wins.

opponent.name: anonymous online humans (random animal names, e.g. 'angry blue elephant')
opponent.avatar_description: no avatar; random adjective-colour-animal name in red text
